plan.notes: Source: Jacksonville University 'Biology (BS) Four-Year Degree Plan' (ju.edu/biology/docs/Biology-BS-4-Year-Plan.pdf). The 2025-2026 JU catalog's Biology section links this document as the sample four-year progression plan ('A sample four year progression plan for students entering as a first year student can be found here'), and every course number/title below was verified against the 2025-2026 catalog (https://ju.edu/academics/25-26_JacksonvilleUniversityCatalog.pdf). No catalog year is printed on the plan PDF itself; catalog_year is set from the current catalog that publishes it. CATALOG RANGE DISCLOSURE: the plan is a 'Courses Recommended' framework with genuine credit ranges. Every range slot is resolved at its MINIMUM here (e.g. 'Core Courses or electives 0-3' = 0; 'Remaining core, electives 9-14' = 9), so the plan totals 100 credits at minimum while the catalog declares 120 — real students fill the core/elective range slots to reach 120; see each slot's choice_note for its full catalog range. OR-slots (BIOL 180/190, MATH 110/140, ENGL 103/CS 150, BIOL 280/290, PHYS 111/151, PHYS 112/152, upper-lab/BIOL 470) occupy one slot each. BIOL 223SI ('fall or spring') is shown in sophomore fall only; it is one 3-credit course taken in either term. MATH 140 (4 cr) is required by the major: the minimum path shows MATH 110 in freshman fall plus MATH 140 in sophomore fall; students placing into MATH 140 skip the sophomore slot. Catalog prereq footnotes carried in notes (not invented): BIOL 280 requires C or better in BIOL 180, ENGL 103, MATH 206, and CS 150 or GEOG 450; BIOL 290 requires C or better in BIOL 190, ENGL 103, MATH 206, CS 150, and one of BIOL 180/CS 160/CHEM 104; BIOL 223SI requires C or better in CHEM 104 and one of BIOL 170/MSC 101/BIOL 180/MSC 111&112/MSC 113&114. The catalog also requires an exit exam (senior year or as part of BIOL 470) and C or better in allied courses. Suggested sequence per pipeline rules. No TCCNS in Florida; transfer_confidence is empty. prereq arrays are empty (per-course prereqs live in the catalog text above, not in the plan table; not duplicated).
